name: Shah Alam East Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Shah Alam East Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 20 December 2026 at Padang Kejiranan Komuniti Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam, with 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races and a 4am half-marathon start.
ai_summary: The Shah Alam East Half Marathon 2026 is held on Sunday 20 December 2026 at Padang Kejiranan Komuniti Bukit Jelutong in Shah Alam, Selangor. The 21 km starts at 4:00 am with a four-hour cut-off, the 10 km at 7:00 am and the 5 km fun run at 7:15 am. It is organised by Puncak Ventures SRA Sdn Bhd with the Bidai Residences Association of Bukit Jelutong, and entry fees run from MYR 40 to MYR 98 before admin fees.

core_facts.organizer: Puncak Ventures SRA Sdn Bhd, with Bidai Residences Association Bukit Jelutong

faqs.question: When is the Shah Alam East Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is on Sunday 20 December 2026. The 21 km flags off at 4:00 am, followed by the 10 km at 7:00 am and the 5 km fun run at 7:15 am. Cut-offs are four hours for the half marathon, two hours for the 10 km and one hour for the 5 km.

faqs.question: What categories and fees are there?
faqs.answer: The 21 km has open (15 to 39) and senior (40 and over) categories for men and women, priced from MYR 65 to MYR 98 across three tiers. The 10 km costs MYR 45 to MYR 78 and the 5 km fun run MYR 40 to MYR 68, all before the platform's admin fee.

faqs.question: Where is the start and finish?
faqs.answer: Everything is based at Padang Kejiranan Komuniti Bukit Jelutong, a neighbourhood field in the Bukit Jelutong area on the eastern side of Shah Alam, Selangor. The event is co-organised with the local Bidai Residences Association, and entries are taken through the RaceXasia registration platform.
